caseName: Watson v. Maine Commissioner of Banking
caseNameFull: WATSON, dba MAINE-WIDE ADJUSTERS v. STATE OF MAINE COMMISSIONER OF BANKING
attorneys: Sanford Jay Rosen, Marvin Karpatkin, Melvin L. Wulf and Malcolm S. Stevenson for appellant., James S. Erwin, Attorney General of Maine, George C. West, Deputy Attorney General, and Jerome S. Matus, Assistant Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
